selector.rationale: Presence of a cystic mass with purulent fluid and the patient's symptoms of nausea, vomiting, and right lower-quadrant abdominal pain support the diagnosis of Tubo-ovarian abscess.

rejected.label: Appendicitis
rejected.why: The appendix appeared clinically normal during surgery and the patient's symptoms and test results do not strongly support appendicitis.

rejected.label: Ovarian cyst
rejected.why: While the patient had a cystic mass, the presence of purulent fluid suggests an infectious process, making Tubo-ovarian abscess a more likely diagnosis.
